{{Quote|The Koensayr BTL-S3 Y-wing attack starfighter, long the staple of the Alliance Fighter Corps. The all-purpose craft has proved its worth as a fighter and [...] a bomber noted for its precision.|[[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]]|<ref name="X:Empire" />}}
The '''BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter''' was a variant configuration of the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]]. It was used primarily by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|The BTL-S3 model's advantage is that the gunner seated behind the pilot is able to use the cockpit ion cannon to find his own targets.|Soontir Fel|<ref name="X:Empire" />}}
The BTL-S3 was the most common Y-wing configuration.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> A two-man strike [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the first crew member [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the craft, while the second acted as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] and controlled the two swivel-mounted [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], located right on top of the cockpit.<ref name="Star Wars Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="RAS" />

Many Y-wings of this variant were [[BTL-S3B Y-wing starfighter|modified]] with defensive rapid-fire [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] turrets replacing the ion cannon turret, and [[Particle beam cannon|particle cannons]] instead of the dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] on the nose.<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> These Y-wings were used as heavy [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] destroyers, and were eventually phased out by the new [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]].

==History==
[[File:Y-wingdetach.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An S3 cockpit module detaches from the main body.]]
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used this variant on his mission to [[Panna/Legends|Panna]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Star Wars Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref> as did [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] on their journey to the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous system]].<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>

The [[Deretta Destroyers]], a mixed starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], consisted of several BTL-S3s. Rebel pilot [[Tenk Lenso]] proved his skill as a gunner in the rear of a BTL-S3 while serving with the Destroyers.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

The Rebel Alliance also used two-person Y-wings at numerous battles during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="BFII" /> and at the [[Battle of Bespin (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="BFI" />

Several of the BTL-S3s were stationed at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. They assisted the base's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] in the evacuation of numerous [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]] through the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] blockade of the planet. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] members [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] escorted the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Thon's Orchard/Legends|''Thon's Orchard'']] to safety using a BTL-S3.<ref name="GG3" />

The Rebel Alliance-affiliated [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Blue Squadron (Bothan)|Blue Squadron]] used 12 Y-wings. Half of them were destroyed on the [[Raid on the Suprosa|Raid]] on the ''[[Suprosa]]''.<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

During the period after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Aggressor Wing]]'s New Republic BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighters commanded by Colonel [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] participated in the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]],<ref name="X:Empire" /> and later rescued Rogue Squadron during the [[evacuation of Ciutric]].<ref name="Mandatory Retirement">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Mandatory Retirement]]''</ref>
[[File:Y-wing_canopy-th.jpg|thumb|left|A BTL-S3 as seen in the Star Wars Holiday Special]]

==Behind the scenes==
The BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter first appeared in [[1978]]'s novel ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'', by [[Alan Dean Foster]], and the first [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] novel.

Both ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]'' mislabel the single-seat [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter]] as the S3 variant.
